audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows read Skill in both layers, so the chart said 'nobody owns this lane' while every whys[] paragraph from level 3 onward describes Graves taking it.
audit.why: Packet chart: Lucian, Skill, Graves, Graves, Graves, Graves, Graves. The mirror flipped both of its charts onto that as one atomic group, so our side has to show the same rows.
audit.corrected: win[0] to Lucian, win[2..6] to Graves, matched to phases[N].side, ratings inverted on rows 0, 2 and 3, and phases[2..6].why rewritten to match the side each now shows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Quickdraw is the tracked cooldown on every page field but no number appeared, and its refund was never mentioned.
audit.why: Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12s AND hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers that cooldown and refreshes the resistance boost. 'Commit on its cooldown' is misleading advice when a farming Graves rarely has it down. Collateral Damage is 100/80/60s.
audit.corrected: The 16s figure and the auto-attack refund written into phases[3].why and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields claim Smoke Screen blinds your autos and Lightslinger. It does not blind.
audit.why: Riot's text: Smoke Screen creates a cloud that REDUCES SIGHT RANGE, and enemies caught in the initial impact take magic damage and are briefly slowed. There is no blind — your autos still land if you can target him. A player who believes he is blinded will stop attacking in the cloud and give up free damage. The mirror already made this correction on Graves's side.
audit.corrected: Blind replaced with the impact slow and the sight cut in whys[2], spikes[1].text, wants.foe[0], early and mid. Also added the New Destiny find: his shotgun fires 4 bullets that CANNOT pass through units, so holding minions between you blanks his damage — written into wants.you[1], early and report[5].t.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Smoke Screen slows and cuts your sight while Quickdraw dodges your Q — his shotgun burst wins level 3.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Quickdraw — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1 but drops every time he lands an auto — you rarely catch it down through levels 4-5.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Collateral Damage is a point-blank execute on your low base HP — never channel The Culling into it.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: His first tanky-ADC item out-bursts your spike — he wins the straight trade once he can reposition and reload on you.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: He out-scales you outright — a tanky build plus rising per-shot burst beats a weak-scaling marksman top. Play tempo.

edits.before: Track Graves’s Quickdraw: Dash + armor stacks — burst him after the charges are spent. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Quickdraw (16s at rank 1, refunded by his autos): it stacks resistances. His bullets cannot pass through units — keep minions between you.

edits.before: Graves hits his spike: smoke screen blinds your autos and Lightslinger while E dodges your Q, and his shotgun burst out-trades you.
edits.after: Graves hits his spike: Smoke Screen slows and cuts your sight while Quickdraw dodges your Q, and his shotgun burst out-trades you.

edits.before: Graves hits his power window: E dash plus smoke screen blinds your autos and Lightslinger, and his burst shotgun out-trades you once he can reposition.
edits.after: Graves hits his power window: Quickdraw plus Smoke Screen's impact slow and sight cut, and his burst shotgun out-trades you once he can reposition.

edits.before: Land his smoke screen to blind your autos and Lightslinger, then burst you with point-blank shotgun shots
edits.after: Land Smoke Screen to slow you and cut your sight, then burst you with point-blank shotgun shots

edits.before: Use W's marked-target move speed to dodge his smoke screen and stay at your auto range, not his shotgun range
edits.after: Keep minions between you — his shotgun bullets cannot pass through units — and hold your auto range, not his

edits.before: Level 1-2 is your only clean window. Your auto range plus a Q-into-Lightslinger double-tap beats his first trade before his shotgun shells reload and before E is up. Land Q through the minion line, then immediately auto for the second Lightslinger shot. The moment he hits 3, respect the smoke screen — it blinds your autos AND your Lightslinger, which is where most of your damage lives. Don't walk into shotgun range to contest a wave once that's online.
edits.after: Level 1-2 is your only clean window. Your auto range plus a Q-into-Lightslinger double-tap beats his first trade before his shells reload and before Quickdraw is up. Land Q through the minion line, then auto immediately for the second Lightslinger shot. From 3 respect Smoke Screen — it slows on impact and blanks your vision inside the cloud, so you lose the target you were kiting. And keep minions between you: his bullets cannot pass through units.

edits.before: From level 3 on this flips. Graves out-ranges nothing of yours but he out-bursts you: E dodges your Q, smoke blinds the follow-up, and a point-blank shotgun chunk beats your double-shot when you can't see to land it. Use W's move-speed proc to disengage out of his shotgun cone rather than to chase — you do not win extended trades into his reload burst. At 6 his R is a flat execute on your low HP, so never channel The Culling at him while he still has dash and ult.
edits.after: From level 3 on this flips. Graves out-ranges nothing of yours but he out-bursts you: Quickdraw dodges your Q, the smoke takes your vision, and a point-blank shotgun chunk beats your double-shot when you cannot see to land it. Attack an Ardent Blaze mark to get the move speed and leave his cone rather than chase — you lose extended trades into his reload burst. At 6 Collateral Damage is a flat execute on your low HP, so never channel The Culling while his dash and ult are up.

notes: Smoke Screen does not blind — it slows on impact and reduces sight range. That error was repeated in five fields and is the single most misleading thing on this page, because it tells the reader their damage is disabled when it is not. Chart was six-of-seven Skill against its own prose and against the mirror; flipped as one atomic group. Added the New Destiny minion-block interaction, which was absent from both layers.
